newsitem.title: DUBAI: Abu Dhabi cuts April crude prices by $1.55-$1.75.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi cuts April crude prices by $1.55-$1.75.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) has cut its April official crude selling prices by $1.55-$1.75 a barrel, a company statement said on Sunday.
Murban was cut by $1.75 to $18.30 a barrel. Lower Zakum and Umm Shaif were reduced by the same amount to $18.35 and $18.05 respectively.
Upper Zakum was reduced by $1.55 to $16.70.
ADNOC sets its official crude prices each month on a retroactive basis on spot market developments.
